sources.title: tsunomaki watame (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It consists of a [[short dress|short]], [[sleeveless dress|sleeveless]] [[fur-trimmed dress|fur-trimmed]] [[white dress]] with a black [[underbust]] band giving an [[empire waist]] effect, a [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[black skirt|black]]  [[miniskirt]] under it, [[detached sleeves|detached]] [[fur-trimmed sleeves|fur-trimmed]] [[ribbed sleeves]], a [[red bowtie]] with a [[brooch]], a [[two-sided cape|two-sided]] [[fur-trimmed cape]], a small [[belt pouch]] and [[black footwear|black]] [[fur-trimmed boots]]. She also carries a [[harp]].
